name: vawe-dark
note: THE VAWE STUDIO, DARK. Not a restyle of the brand: these are the tokens `studio/server.mjs` ships behind the studio's ◐ toggle (and THEME=dark), lifted verbatim, so a film framed in this palette is framed in the instrument's own colours. Cyberpunk here means LIGHT IN A DARK ROOM, not neon-on-black: the field is the near-black stage #0b0d12, the only bright surfaces are the instrument and the frame it is previewing, and exactly two hues carry meaning. Mint #5ee0c8 (12:1) is the accent and the state of a thing that has run; #ff4d6d is the studio's own playhead-and-alarm red (6:1) and it is spent ONLY on the hazard band and its measurement, so a red in this film always means a hole. Faces are unchanged from the light brand, Anybody + JetBrains Mono, because the product did not change its typography when it turned the lights off.
